comment: Defines constants used by the FLAC extractor.

variables.name: STREAM_MARKER_SIZE
variables.comment: Size of the FLAC stream marker in bytes.

variables.name: METADATA_BLOCK_HEADER_SIZE
variables.comment: Size of the header of a FLAC metadata block in bytes.

variables.name: STREAM_INFO_BLOCK_SIZE
variables.comment: Size of the FLAC stream info block (header included) in bytes.

variables.name: MIN_FRAME_HEADER_SIZE
variables.comment: Minimum size of a FLAC frame header in bytes.

variables.name: MAX_FRAME_HEADER_SIZE
variables.comment: Maximum size of a FLAC frame header in bytes.
